King of Boxing, The.name: Victory Boxing
King of Boxing, The.summary: Your goal is to topple the Champ, a perfect fighter who was born to become the heavyweight champion of the world. But, you must defeat 30 Chumps to get to the Champ, and they won't go down without a fight. Work on your jabs, hooks, and uppercuts along with your blocking and footwork. Master the devastating multi-hit combos, and you just might have a shot at the Champ. But will you be good enough?

Scud - The Disposable Assassin.name: Scud: The Disposable Assassin
Scud - The Disposable Assassin.summary: SCUD: The Disposable Assassin is a video game based on the Rob Schrab comic series of the same name.

Sega Worldwide Soccer '98.name: Sega Worldwide Soccer '98
Sega Worldwide Soccer '98.summary: Sega Worldwide Soccer is a series of soccer games by Sega for initially for the Sega Saturn but later was moved to the Dreamcast. They were released between 1995 and the year 2000.

Snatcher.name: Snatcher
Snatcher.summary:
Snatcher is a graphic adventure game produced by Konami. It was originally released for the Japanese PC-8801 and MSX2 computers in 1988 and later remade for the Super CD-ROM in 1992. In 1994, a Sega Mega-CD version was made specifically for the West and released in North America and Europe (without any equivalent version on the Japanese Mega-CD). In 1996, the game was re-released in Japan once again, this time on the Sega Saturn and PlayStation.

It was written and directed by Hideo Kojima, who would go on to become famous thanks to the success of the Metal Gear Solid series, although he was not directly involved with the Mega-CD version or the later 32-bit console versions. It was followed by a spiritual successor, Policenauts, which Kojima also wrote and directed.
